suppress.notes: Suppress CVE-2026-29062 for tools.jackson.core on Spring Boot 4.0.3. Upgrading to Jackson 3.1.0+ causes ExceptionInInitializerError (NoClassDefFoundError) due to a framework mismatch with Jackson 2.x annotations expecting JsonSerializeAs. Waiting for Spring Boot upstream upgrade.
